name: Cubby Allowance
description: A pocket money jar. It pays a set allowance to a child once per period, and only the owner’s Cubby passkey vault can top it up, change it, or close it.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: The parent. Funds and manages the jar from their Cubby vault.

claimer.name: Claimer
claimer.description: Anyone who pulls the allowance for the child. The money can only go to the child.

createJar.name: Start a pocket money jar
createJar.description: Lock coins in a jar that pays the child once per period.

claimAllowance.name: Pay this period’s allowance
claimAllowance.description: Pay one allowance to the child and put the rest back in the jar.

claimLast.name: Pay what is left
claimLast.description: When less than one allowance is left, pay all of it to the child.

manageJar.name: Top up or close the jar
manageJar.description: Spend the owner’s Cubby vault in the same transaction. The vault checks the passkey signed every output.

createJarTransaction.name: Pocket money jar started
createJarTransaction.description: Put $(<fundSatoshis>) satoshis in a jar that pays $(<allowance>) every $(<periodBlocks>) blocks.

claimLastTransaction.name: Last allowance paid
claimLastTransaction.description: Paid the rest of the jar to the child.

manageTransaction.name: Jar managed
manageTransaction.description: The owner set the jar to $(<newJarSatoshis>) satoshis.

jarClaimInput.name: Jar coins
jarClaimInput.description: The jar coin, aged at least one period.

jarManageInput.name: Jar coins
jarManageInput.description: The jar coin being topped up or closed.

ownerVaultInput.name: Owner’s Cubby vault
ownerVaultInput.description: Unlocked by the owner’s passkey outside XO: the passkey signs a hash of every output, and the vault script checks it on chain. Added as a commit with its own unlocking bytecode, after the outputs are final.

jarChange.name: Pocket money jar
jarChange.description: What is left in the jar after this period.

childPayoutLast.name: Last allowance
childPayoutLast.description: Everything left in the jar, for the child.

vaultChange.name: Back to the vault
vaultChange.description: The rest returns to the owner’s Cubby vault.

allowanceJar.name: Cubby Allowance jar
allowanceJar.description: Pays $(<allowance>) satoshis to the child every $(<periodBlocks>) blocks. Only the owner’s Cubby vault can change it.

minerFeeSatoshis.name: Network fee
minerFeeSatoshis.description: Fixed fee the jar pays on each claim (MINER_FEE in the contract).

ownerVaultLock.name: Owner vault
ownerVaultLock.description: Locking script of the owner’s Cubby vault.

periodBlocks.name: Blocks per period
periodBlocks.description: How many blocks the jar waits between payments (about 144 a day).

jarSatoshis.name: Jar amount
jarSatoshis.description: Satoshis in the jar coin being spent.

newJarSatoshis.name: New jar amount
newJarSatoshis.description: Satoshis in the jar after the owner’s change.

vaultSatoshis.name: Vault amount
vaultSatoshis.description: Satoshis in the owner’s vault coin.

vaultFeeSatoshis.name: Vault fee
vaultFeeSatoshis.description: Network fee for the passkey-checked spend (about 1 satoshi per byte of a 10 kB transaction).

resources.name: Cubby
resources.description: Seedless BCH vault opened with a passkey checked on chain.
